# v0.10.0b8 — Saving a car works again

- Fixed: with a saved vehicle list that is no longer valid (for example after the `departure_*` rename of 0.10.0b7), saving a car left the list empty. The car now starts a fresh list, so the device no longer has to be removed and set up again.
- Everything else is as in 0.10.0b7, which was withdrawn.

The app stays at **0.10.0b7**; only the integration changes. Update the integration to **0.10.0b8**. Not tested on real hardware.

Every contribution is voluntary and very welcome; support and new features stay open to everyone either way.
